name: Fun facts for kids
description: Cheerful numbered lists of simple, true facts about animals, nature and space for young children.

definition.brief: Each video shares simple, true and cheerful facts about one thing young children love, such as an animal, the weather or the sky. Use short sentences, everyday words and one fun detail per fact. Nothing frightening.
definition.music_mood: bright, playful ukulele and xylophone music, light and happy

intro_line.en: Hello, little explorers! Welcome to {series}. Let's learn something fun!
intro_line.ta: வணக்கம், சின்ன நண்பர்களே! {series} உங்களை வரவேற்கிறது. சுவையான ஒன்றைக் கற்போம்!

outro_line.en: Thank you for learning with us. See you next time!
